events.text: Slitting mill in Saugus, Massachusetts cuts iron bars into rods for nailsmiths
Nail cutting and heading machines running near Boston
Earliest known potato chip recipe, in The Cook's Oracle, London
Roughly the end of the hand-forged nail, at about a minute per nail
The Saratoga Springs invention story is set here. It is a myth
First American patent for wire nails
Wire nails made on a large scale in the US
Granite State Potato Chip Factory opens, one of America's first chip makers
Smiths Potato Crisps starts in the UK, bags with a twist of salt
Wire nails dominate. Only 8 percent of nails made are cut nails
Coloured nail polish takes off. Antoine de Paris makes some of the first modern polishes
Standard Statistics launches its first stock index, 233 companies
Painting the whole nail becomes the fashion
Tayto makes the first seasoned crisp, cheese and onion
The index grows to 500 companies and becomes the S&P 500 (4 March)
Smith's launches salt and vinegar nationally
Cape Cod Potato Chips starts the kettle chip
Nail guns appear in the Sears catalogue for the first time
US nail polish sales hit a record $768 million, up 32 percent on 2011
